concepts.meaning: Connectivity transition of the edited cell: whether parent and child retain an input-output path and the sign of change in effective path count.
Background path multiplicity versus how many edited slots already lie on effective parent paths, distinguishing sparse from dense live contexts.
Post-edit coverage of edited slots across effective child paths, including whether any path avoids all edits.
Presence of convolution on effective paths before and after the edit and the sign of change in effective convolution edges.
Change in effective skip edges alongside untouched convolution or pooling context remaining on parent paths.
Whether two edited slots co-occur on a shared parent or child path and whether one edited edge feeds another.
Topological relation of two edited edges by common source node or common destination node.
Branching and merging structure of the effective parent path graph as background for the edit.
Parent path count combined with branch and merge topology, characterizing the pre-edit routing skeleton.
Child path count, path-count sign change, and edited-slot coverage on child paths as post-edit consequences.
Shift in edited-slot liveness from parent to child and whether edits converge on a shared child path.
Convolution context on parent paths versus unmodified convolution and the sign of convolution-edge change after editing.
